review.decision: Verify the early workspace reply hold against the same durable submission ID.
review.notes: Use a synthetic exact Codex target, a private spool and injected dispatch IO. Check two early hold causes without opening any live session.

cases.description: A reply with prior native submission evidence cannot be recovered as unsubmitted.
cases.setup: Build fresh, unclaimed, claimed, accepted and refused records under a private HOME.
cases.action: Present stale-premise and unavailable-native-route holds before dispatch for each ID.
cases.expected: Claimed or accepted IDs are not authorized for resend. Fresh, unclaimed and explicitly refused IDs retain the early hold behavior. No submit or terminal mutation occurs.
